name: Feature request
about: Suggest a new module, capability, or improvement
title: ""
labels: enhancement
assignees: ''
---

## Problem

What user problem does this solve? Describe the DJ workflow that hurts today.

## Proposed solution

A clear and concise description of what you want to happen.

## Alternatives considered

What other approaches have you thought about, and why is the proposed one better?

## Scope

- Which module(s) does this affect? (tracklist, social, epk, gigs, finance, …)
- Is this a new module, an addition to an existing one, or cross-cutting
  (infra, design system, docs)?
- Frontend only / backend only / both?

## Mockups / examples

Screenshots, wireframes, sample API payloads, or links to similar features in
other tools are all helpful.

## Additional context

Anything else that helps reviewers evaluate the proposal.
